sentences.text: Constellate computed a modest symptom similarity between cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis and hereditary spastic paraplegia 11, with a score of 0.199 over 22 shared terms [e_dc4838a109f0].
The top shared term is an abnormal nerve test result called EMG axonal abnormality [e_dc4838a109f0].
This link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it from symptom terms, and it is not a database finding [e_dc4838a109f0].

The causes are different in curated databases: cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis is tied to the gene CYP27A1, while hereditary spastic paraplegia 11 is tied to the gene SPG11 [e_bf3d3c7f30ae] [e_ce8a3471f532].

For cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis, two observed features are recorded in OMIM, raised cholestanol in spinal fluid and a brain wave test with generalized slow activity [e_b23e0cbf8118] [e_5fdbf8c9c69c].
These edges do not show a shared cause, because the two genes differ [e_bf3d3c7f30ae] [e_ce8a3471f532].
They also do not show any studies or treatments, and they do not show that the two conditions behave alike beyond the computed score [e_dc4838a109f0].
